notion.guide.step1.title: Create an integration
notion.guide.step1.body: In Notion, under notion.so/profile/integrations, create an internal integration with Read, Update and Insert Content.
notion.guide.step2.title: Save the API key
notion.guide.step2.body: Paste the token into the API key field. The browser never receives saved keys back.
notion.guide.step3.title: Share the page
notion.guide.step3.body: Create a Notion page for StudyRunner data and invite the integration with full access.
notion.guide.step4.title: Set the Parent Page ID
notion.guide.step4.body: Enter the 32 characters from the Notion page URL into the Active Study Target settings.

stimulus.editorNote: Warm-up only shows the instruction view. Study signals, BrainBit routing, Mini-radar recording, camera snapshots, media triggers, and custom JS start when the active timer begins. HTML and JS trigger types stay blocked unless the server explicitly enables STUDY_RUNNER_ALLOW_UNSAFE_STIMULUS_CODE=1.
